purpose: Factual and algorithm review, separate from automated development checkpoint selection. Written before training checkpoint results.

science-sound: Sound requires a material medium to transmit mechanical disturbances.
A vacuum lacks that medium; it is not a solid.
science-shadow: The Sun's apparent elevation changes as Earth rotates.
A low Sun produces a longer shadow; a higher Sun produces a shorter shadow for the same pole.
science-ice: Ordinary ice is less dense than liquid water.
Its open molecular arrangement makes the same mass occupy more volume.
Buoyancy permits it to float; coldness alone is not an explanation.
science-orbit: Gravity remains substantial at spacecraft orbital altitudes.
Spacecraft and astronauts fall together around Earth; orbital motion prevents falling directly into the ground.
Apparent weightlessness does not mean the absence of gravity.
legacy-photosynthesis: Photosynthesis uses light energy, carbon dioxide, and water to build sugars, releasing oxygen.
Cellular respiration releases usable energy from fuel; aerobic respiration consumes oxygen and produces carbon dioxide and water.
Plants perform both processes; photosynthesis requires light while respiration is not restricted to nighttime.
legacy-spoon: At equal initial temperature, metal and wood are not different temperatures merely because they feel different.
Metal transfers heat from warmer skin faster because of its greater thermal conductivity.

programs.general: Pass all supplied execution tests and comply with explicitly requested algorithm and signature. Execution coverage remains limited.
programs.legacy-binary-search: Must narrow the search interval using a middle element. A linear scan receives no full-requirements credit even if all I/O tests pass.

completion: An answer that reaches the cap is not automatically a loop; an answer ending with EOS is not automatically correct. Record both separately.
